**This is an automated reply confirming we received your email/request.**

Access our new attorney portal to e-sign liens, view bills, balances, reports, images and pay online @ Precise.RadFlow360.com

Please allow three full business days for a response. (Business hours: Mon-Fri 9am-5pm).

If you do not receive a response within the allotted time, please call to follow up on your email/request. 

New address for mailing payments:

Precise Imaging
PO Box 510626
Livonia MI 48151

IMPORTANT INFO BEFORE SUBMITTING PAYMENT

  1. Two liens per case must be signed. E-sign all liens instantly. 
    1. One for the images and 
    2. One for the radiologist report
  2. Submit a negotiation offer for your client's bill.
    1. Payments submitted without an accepted negotiation offer will be rejected and returned to sender.
  3. Pay online via credit card, ACH or mail a check.

Thank you for your cooperation to ensure a speedy turnaround time for your client and our patient.

To submit a negotiation, please email offer@precisemri.com or submit online via the attorney portal

If you are requesting reports, records or images and to avoid any delays, please access the attorney portal @ www.Precise.RadFlow360.comhttps://precise.radflow360.com/

Thank you!
